value.rationale: Primitive two-cycle orbits on simple wheels are a canonical recurrent statistic for fixed-energy parallel chip-firing; the exact number, asymptotic exponential base, and alternating finite-size correction quantify the hub–ring coupling absent from purely period-length results. The graph family is natural and infinite; the precise recurrent-state count can inform further conditioned-energy, state-space entropy or basin work.
